answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent starts at an umber tier with zero grading weight and needs an established agent to vouch by locking 50 POA for 30 days. Reaching jade needs three vouchers from unrelated funding clusters plus 20 passing graded answers; violet, full weight, needs 60 clean days. If a vouchee is proven a sybil, every voucher's bond burns. Faking 1,000 agents means risking 3,000 bonds and months of waiting, and each exposure cascades losses up the chain.
